title: Bodycam Footage Shows Gunfire Exchange with Logan County Deputies and Suspect
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Logan County, Oklahoma — On April 2, 2025, around 1:30 p.m., Logan County Sheriff Deputies Kayoomars Niroomandi and Captain Tom Kutay responded to the trailer home for reports of a fight between a couple. A 911 caller told dispatchers her ex-husband, 45-year-old Jeremy Dean Barnett, was harassing her, and told dispatch he had a warrant. Captain Kutay approaches the door of the home, and is told by a female that Barnett is hiding near the pool. When walking toward the pool, Captain Kutay begins to call him out by name. Barnett began shooting at the two deputies. Bodycam shows Captain Kutay starting to duck, and then later being struck. 

Later video shows blood dripping from the deputy's upper body onto his hands. Deputy Niroomandi is also struck, calling into the radio, he has been hit. Both eventually went for cover. A third deputy, Major Greg Randolph, was taking cover behind trees managed to fire back hitting Barnett who then got away. A short time later and after asking for help from McIntyre Law Chopper 4 to find Barnett, he was found dead. The two deputies shot are both doing okay and suffered minor injuries. Three deputies were placed on routine administrative leave. The OSBI, which investigated the officer-involved shooting, has turned its findings over to the District Attorney's office.
